freeze_suppression_reason: decision_rule_reachability = FAIL (see freeze_eligibility). Per design-contract v2, a FAIL in any freeze_eligibility check forbids freezing; a fail-loud certificate is the licensed terminal deliverable (request.json mandate option A).

certificate_verdict.summary: A >=2-anchor D1V frame IS constructible today ({P3-MW-ARCH, P4-MW-GENTOO}, 12 D1V trials, 2 anchors) - the anchor-count precondition the parent's single-anchor read could not meet is satisfiable. HOWEVER the powered non-degenerate read (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V with LOW>0 AND LOW<UB97) is arithmetically UNCONSTRUCTIBLE on the observed substrate: CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires 0 times on all 12 D1V trials (and 0 times on the 18-trial union including inherited CAL-POS-2), forcing per-anchor incumbent FA=1.0 homogeneous => LOW==UB97==1.0 zero-width interval. Both decisive branches (INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED, INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND) are unreachable; the sole reachable outcome is DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE. decision_rule_reachability=FAIL => freeze refused; the certificate is the terminal deliverable, the Part II route is parked with a positive-control-backed bounded reason, and the product answer for C-FRESHNESS remains UNKNOWN (no claim change).
certificate_verdict.binding_constraint: FIELD-SET-HOMOGENEITY (per-anchor incumbent FA=1.0 on every D1V-capable anchor because postcond fires 0 times). CORRECTION to the prior attempt's ANCHOR_SCARCITY_OTHER attribution: anchor scarcity is NOT the binding constraint - M-N-D1V-ANCHORS>=2 is satisfiable (2 live anchors); the binding constraint is zero postcond fires on all D1V trials.

not_constructible.why: LOW==UB97==1.0 (zero-width): 0/12 postcond fires => per-anchor FA_inc=1.0 on both anchors => pooled diff=1.0 with zero bootstrap variance

divergence_disclosure: Prior attempt (same day, earlier K=3 probe) reported P1-OSM-RAILS and P6-MASTODON as transport-stable D1V-capable ('4 transport-stable candidates'). Today's K=4 GET-only cookieless probe observes body-derived ETags on 4/4 sessions of both (ETag == sha256(body)[:32] exactly) => they are TRANSPORT-COUPLED today, not D1V-capable. Transport-signature issuance is time-variable on these platforms; the prior attempt's 4-anchor claim is superseded by re-observation. Core certificate conclusion is unaffected (rests on the 2 confirmed D1V-capable anchors + inherited CAL-POS-2).
Prior attempt simulated the would-be read with B=20000. This certificate uses the frozen binding estimator.DEFAULT_B=10000 with seed=37992949248 - the exact parameters a frozen EXECUTE would use.

question: Is there a constructible >=2-anchor D1V frame on a materially different population on which a powered non-degenerate M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V read can decide INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED vs INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND?
hypothesis: If a powered frame is constructible, the blindness mechanism generalizes to a multi-anchor population (decision-relevant for C-FRESHNESS). If not constructible and the sole reachable branch is DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE due to field-set homogeneity (0 postcond fires), then the Part II anchored read cannot exist on the observed substrate and the route must be parked.
falsifier: Any future observation in which CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires on at least one D1V pair of a value-bearing anchor (new capture date, new instance, or new platform family) reopens the non-degenerate frame for that population. The certificate explicitly predicts this has not happened as of the 2026-10-10 probe window (0/12 probe D1V pairs, 0/6 inherited CAL-POS-2 D1V pairs).

estimator_power_arithmetic.binding: estimator.anchor_clustered_paired_fa_diff, B=estimator.DEFAULT_B=10000, seed=37992949248 (FROZEN_SEED) - identical to a would-be EXECUTE
estimator_power_arithmetic.theorem: On any D1V trial: value-aware ABSTAINS (CH-PRECOND-BINDING fires) => FA_va=0; incumbent REUSEs iff no other channel fires; D1V guarantees no structural/transport change and (when postcond postcond_change=false) no postcond fire => incumbent FA=1.0 per trial. Pooled diff = bootstrap-resampled mean of per-anchor FA. LOW<UB97 (non-degenerate) iff some anchor has per-anchor FA != 1.0 iff CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires on at least one D1V pair.

definitions.D1V: label==STALE AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change
definitions.structural_change: structure_signature(recorded session) != structure_signature(current session), structure_signature=(type_class, form_action, form_method, tuple(form_input_names))
definitions.transport_change: transport_signature(recorded session) != transport_signature(current session), transport_signature=(ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary), OR final_url differs
definitions.postcond_change: session in-list field-name set differs between recorded and current session (CH-POSTCOND-SEM)
definitions.endpoint_change: per-instance form_action differs (recorded vs current extraction)
definitions.label: STALE iff live value != recorded value byte-exact (CH-PRECOND-BINDING analogue)
